Aberration · 3 hexes · SM +3 Otyugh [Monster Manual, page 204]

A barrel of mottled hide standing on three splayed legs, with a tooth-lined maw opening in the front of its body, small eyes clustered above it, and two long tentacle-arms ending in rough gripping pads. It lives in filth by preference, eats anything, and can be smelled long before the corridor turns.
